name: Ryuusei Tenshi Primaveil
original_name: 流聖天使プリマヴェール
source:
Main character is an executive of a secret evil society that manages to capture the justice idol heroine. His job is to train her into an obedient slave. But there is another justice heroine still fighting the organization. It would be perfect to catch her and train into pet as well.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一个秘密邪恶社团的执行官，设法捕获了正义偶像女主角。他的工作就是把她训练成一个听话的奴隶。但还有另一位正义女英雄仍在与该组织作斗争。如果能抓住她并训练成宠物就完美了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
